opportunities.title: Make API migration reviewable
opportunities.thesis: A failing migration consumes expert attention; verified compatibility tooling can remove repeated work.
opportunities.goal: Build and verify an API compatibility migration kit.
opportunities.successMetric: Run 120 synthetic compatibility cases across the declared API versions; retain every failure and prove zero undocumented behavior changes.

opportunities.title: Turn grid queues into an evidence map
opportunities.thesis: Public queue tables can support reproducible bottleneck analysis before infrastructure decisions.
opportunities.goal: Reproduce a public grid-queue bottleneck analysis.
opportunities.successMetric: Reconcile 500 synthetic queue records exactly, retain source provenance, and reproduce all tables and constraint classifications with independent review.

opportunities.title: Make a materials claim reproducible
opportunities.thesis: A reproducible numerical pipeline can expose where a promising scientific claim stops holding.
opportunities.goal: Build a materials-model numerical reproduction.
opportunities.successMetric: Reproduce three declared synthetic benchmark curves within 1 percent, report sensitivity and failed regimes, and retain executable environment instructions.

opportunities.title: Stress-test a brittle supply plan
opportunities.thesis: An executable capacity model can expose missed delivery obligations before a planning commitment.
opportunities.goal: Build a supply capacity and recovery stress test.
opportunities.successMetric: Conserve all units across 200 synthetic order events, exercise five capacity shocks, and report late and unfinished obligations without discarding failures.

opportunities.title: Audit a public research data pipeline
opportunities.thesis: Reproducible dataset validation can improve research quality without making clinical decisions.
opportunities.goal: Build an auditable public research data validation package.
opportunities.successMetric: Pass 80 synthetic schema and provenance checks, reject seeded leakage and missingness faults, and show no patient-level or clinical decision outputs.

opportunities.title: Measure learning-tool failure modes
opportunities.thesis: A transparent evaluation pack can reveal unsupported answers and weak transfer before a tool is adopted.
opportunities.goal: Build an independently replayable learning-tool evaluation pack.
opportunities.successMetric: Evaluate 100 authored public-domain or synthetic cases against a frozen rubric, retain all outputs, and report error rates separately from coverage.

opportunities.title: A bold claim with a missing foundation
opportunities.thesis: A broad autonomy claim deserves a demanding test before its optimistic score influences deployment.
opportunities.goal: Test a cross-sector autonomous-execution claim.
opportunities.successMetric: Execute a preregistered public synthetic task set, retain all attempts and independent judgments, and report useful completions, failures, cost and review minutes.

opportunities.title: Expose routing assumptions
opportunities.thesis: A reproducible route planner can make feasibility and robustness inspectable before dispatch.
opportunities.goal: Build a transport routing feasibility audit.
opportunities.successMetric: Recompute 60 synthetic routing instances, prove capacity and time-window conservation, compare a declared baseline and retain infeasible cases.
